literal: With the body, the soul, between, what kind of [bond], then, like that, with the young woman, my, between, the love.
translation: The love between this young woman and me is just like the inseparable bond that exists between the body and the soul.
modern: உடம்புக்கும் உயிருக்கும் இடையே உள்ள உறவு எத்தகையதோ, அத்தகையதே இந்த இளம் பெண்ணுக்கும் எனக்கும் இடையே உள்ள காதல் உறவு ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet beautifully illustrates the depth of love by comparing it to the relationship between the physical body and the life-giving soul. The words 'உடம்பொடு' (with the body) and 'உயிர்' (soul) represent two distinct entities that cannot exist without each other. The phrase 'என்ன மற்று அன்ன' sets up the comparison, meaning 'just as that is, so is this'. By describing their 'நட்பு' (which here means intimate love) in this manner, the speaker emphasizes that their connection is not merely physical or temporary, but vital to their very existence.
